_doc: Bot Training (PLAN §15; game/shared/src/bots/DESIGN.md §2): bots fill every empty slot of both teams when the host starts. Its rules start as Unranked's (data/modes/unranked.json says where each comes from) without bans, and the host sets them all: your side (attack only, defense only, or alternating every round: the default), the team sizes (1–5 each, uneven allowed), each team's bot difficulty, the site (the defenders' bots vote for it, or a fixed one), the round count and the bots' operator picks. No local stats or rating: Bot Training keeps its own (DESIGN §11).
